golden_suite_note: Suite hash covers the eval harness; evals/lookback.py and evals/recall_regression.py changed, the six case fixtures did not.

limitations: A fresh but unrelated tool result cited as validation still lets the model promote an echo; deterministic checks establish eligibility, not relevance.
An unsourced memory_ingest restatement of a recalled fact is still accepted as uncertain.
status: conflict reflects every matching conflict record, including partial matches outside the returned page; an intent decision for the author.

Dynamic nested calls (aliases, tools?.x, spaced brackets), servers named memories (mcp__mem0__search_memories) and memory-bank directories not named memory/ are not recognized; isMeta user text ends a turn.
Recalled fact IDs are capped at 200 in sorted order.
tests/test_revision_overlay.py counts memory spaces database-wide, so it flakes when another test run shares the disposable database.
Historical echoes are retained; no automatic retraction or bulk re-extraction.
